Traditional tale: 神农尝百草

Earlier scenes:
古代的时候，一个男人觉得植物很有意思。他叫神农。有的植物吃了以后他的肚子疼死了，可是有的吃了以后很舒服。他找很多植物。凉山很大的山，这也找植物。一天，他找到黄色的花。他听说你跟黄色的花做茶很有用。比方说，你的头发疼死，这冰茶是药。他一喝茶就很不舒服。

This scene:
糟糕，这黄色的花是夹竹桃，特别是毒。正好在这儿，灵芝药的夹竹桃他吃完了，也写一个课文的植物。谢谢神农。

Expressiveness ideas:
1. Add how Shennong feels after eating the poisonous flower, such as a very painful stomachache. e.g. 他的肚子疼死了。
2. Add a short question from Shennong when he feels better, to show his surprise about the medicine plant. e.g. 神农问：“这是什么药？”
3. Add a final comment about why Shennong is great: he was not afraid of danger and helped many people. e.g. 神农不怕危险，帮了很多人。

ideas.reason: It adds a clear physical reaction to the poisonous plant and fits the situation.
It adds a simple, natural line of surprise after he is helped by a medicine plant.
It gives an appropriate concluding reason that Shennong is admirable in the traditional tale.
